reason: A read-only plugin safety utility that statically scans plugin sources and dependencies for risky patterns and evaluates destructive commands against workspace boundaries.

summaries.zh: 用于在安装插件前静态扫描本地目录或 npm 包中的风险模式，并评估潜在破坏性命令的安全工具。
summaries.en: A read-only utility that statically scans local directories or npm packages for risky patterns before installation and evaluates potentially destructive commands.

capabilities: Reads and statically scans local plugin directories and npm tarballs
Checks exact-version dependencies against Google OSV when enabled
Evaluates potentially destructive commands and file deletions
Injects prompt guidance for scan and guard usage
